zh.title: 一块围栏怎么变成界面

steps.title: 识别围栏
steps.desc: 正文里出现 ```dsh-ui 代码块，语言标记就已足够

steps.title: 解析 JSON
steps.desc: 只做标点级容错；结构错误不会被猜

steps.title: 归一化与校验
steps.desc: 别名转规范字段、未知字段告警、预算与深度上限

steps.title: 渲染节点
steps.desc: 白名单节点逐个映射到 DOM，没有任意 HTML 路径

items.title: 每个阶段各做一步
items.caption: 横轴是四个步骤，纵轴是三个阶段；「—」表示该阶段不处理这一步。

items.title: 容错有边界
items.content: 缺括号、错括号这类结构错误不会被修——渲染器宁可显示源码和诊断，也不猜你想写什么。

en.title: How one fence becomes an interface

steps.title: Find the fence
steps.desc: A ```dsh-ui code block in the reply body; the language tag is enough

steps.title: Parse the JSON
steps.desc: Only punctuation-level repair; structural errors are never guessed

steps.title: Normalize and validate
steps.desc: Aliases to canonical fields, unknown-field warnings, budget and depth caps

steps.title: Render the nodes
steps.desc: Whitelisted nodes map to the DOM one by one, with no arbitrary-HTML path

items.title: One step per stage
items.caption: Columns are the four steps, rows are the three stages; the dash marks a step a stage does not handle.

items.title: Repair has a boundary
items.content: Missing or mismatched brackets are never repaired — the renderer would rather show the source and a diagnostic than guess what you meant.
